optimization_analysis: The two consecutive SEM_FILTER operators can be fused into a single semantic filter with a compound predicate. Both filters operate on the same document binding and perform related classification tasks that can be evaluated together in one LLM call, reducing the number of semantic operations from 2 to 1 while preserving correctness.

optimized_semantic_plan.program:
SCAN_DOCS(CONTRACTEXHIBIT, all)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep genuine SOX Section 302 certifications that contain the material-changes disclosure clause for internal control over financial reporting AND whose clause uses only generic certification language describing no specific control change', input_bindings={document: text})
-> GROUP_BY(keys=[], aggs=[COUNT(*) AS certification_count])
